rules.description: Keep changes inside the authority granted by the task and preserve protected files.
Ground code-review findings in repository behavior and submit only the requested review artifact.
Communicate outcomes, plans, evidence, caveats, and status with appropriate brevity.
rules.limitation: The deterministic task result scores repository artifacts, not conversational quality.

rules.description: Use subagents only for bounded work and validate delegated results.
rules.limitation: The harness does not expose a vendor-neutral collaboration trace or subagent contract.

rules.description: Diagnose the behavioral root cause and repair it without hiding the regression.
Ask before destructive, public, costly, security-sensitive, or scope-expanding actions.
rules.limitation: Offline synthetic tasks grant fixed authority and cannot safely score real approvals or external side effects.

rules.description: Carry ordered work through fresh contexts while preserving prior behavior.
Preserve product hierarchy, input, recovery, accessibility, responsive behavior, and visible UI states.
rules.limitation: The development corpus has no user-interface task or visual runtime surface.

rules.description: Keep linear flows linear and avoid unnecessary abstraction or speculative structure.
rules.limitation: Equivalent implementations are accepted; the deterministic verifier does not impose a universal style metric.

rules.description: Model inputs at boundaries, reject malformed states, and preserve immutable inputs.
Surface partial success and recovery instead of hiding intermediate outcomes.
rules.limitation: The tasks cover retryable failure and recovery states but not mixed-success batch operations.

rules.description: Benchmark performance-sensitive changes with before-and-after evidence.
rules.limitation: No current task has a performance contract or benchmark-sensitive hot path.

rules.description: Represent state transitions and external effects as deterministic data without performing I/O.
Use closed retry, cancellation, concurrency, and recovery states with bounded transient retries.
Avoid unchecked Any, casts, and type-ignore directives when validated types are available.
Prevent secrets and full payloads from crossing logs or structured event boundaries.
rules.limitation: The synthetic task covers only omission of secret-shaped message and payload data from a typed event record; credentials, loggers, and transports remain out of scope.

rules.description: Classify boundary failures with stable kinds and preserve causes and context.
rules.limitation: The watch task requires a stable taxonomy and prose-independent classification, but no task preserves a real exception cause chain.

rules.description: Extend the closest structured owner instead of introducing a parallel script or command path.
Emit structured boundary events with stable fields, redaction, and one record per failure.
Choose implementation languages and tools appropriate to an unconstrained greenfield problem.
rules.limitation: All public tasks provide an existing Python repository and intentionally constrain the implementation surface.

rules.description: Keep documentation portable and add comments only for non-obvious invariants or external constraints.
rules.limitation: Patch-task authority excludes documentation and does not score source-comment quality.

rules.description: Follow commit, push, pull-request, review-aid, and feedback-delivery contracts.
rules.limitation: The harness evaluates an isolated worktree before repository delivery operations.

rules.description: Run relevant gates and provide revision-bound evidence that agrees with an independent verifier.
